market_question: Will Oliver Bearman be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?
reasoning: Oliver Bearman is unlikely to be in a championship-winning seat for 2026. He is a 2025 rookie, and top teams have committed drivers. The true probability is extremely low (≈0.01%), while the market implies 0.2%, making 'No' significantly underpriced.
evidence_points: Bearman will enter his second F1 season in 2026; only Hamilton (2008) managed a second-year title, and that required a top car.
Top teams have locked-in driver lineups (Verstappen, Leclerc/Hamilton, Norris/Piastri, Russell/Antonelli likely) leaving Bearman in midfield.
Haas, his team for 2025, rarely challenges for wins, and 2026 regulation changes are unlikely to instantly transform them into title contenders.
sources_consulted: News articles on Hamilton's multi-year Ferrari contract
